proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived normalized full-record lower obstructions and total four-criterion attainable brackets; a scoped second solve added a supplied-selection polynomial upper of (n log(en))^(-1/4) and oracle-order separation through alpha=1/9. Mathematical review passed, but the original matched sharp-frontier contract remains unsolved: exact logarithms, learned-selection rates, preservation above 1/9 and mixed-information penalties are open. No F stage or Lean proof was attempted; independent terminal validity confirmed downgrade to incremental, with re-raise requiring new mathematics rather than a positioning edit.
tldr: For the given marginal causal squared Hellinger functional, singular-score geometry, normalized full-record lower obstructions, and total finite-sample honest inference are proved over the unchanged model with density zeros and equal marginal laws. An explicit supplied-selection localized polynomial procedure improves the achievable order to \(\{n\log(\mathrm e n)\}^{-1/4}\), and learning selection provably loses oracle order for \(\alpha\in[1/20,1/9]\), including the endpoint. The four sharp minimax orders and the possible additional coupled-information penalty remain open; the separate lower-obstruction maximum is not declared the answer.
